_about: Polestar's public quest mechanics: how a quest is done beyond its objectives, in our own words, ids and positions. `forge data build --kb` merges it over the private mechanics layers by their rules, into data/forever/mechanics.json. quests: { "<quest id>": { kinds, params, steps, note } }. kinds: [{ kind, confidence }]: kind is one of escort, timed, summon-by-item, use-item-at-place, use-item-on-mob, object-click, vendor-buy, crafted, event-start, group/elite, item-from-other-quest, multi-step-in-one-objective, delayed-offer, other; confidence high, medium (default) or low. A kind gains the source `public`; it drives the route when it is high or another source agrees with it; a kind the server data refutes is not added. params: [{ kind, ... }]: the kind's parameters (for example delayed-offer: after, npc, sec; summon-by-item: item, npc); they join a kind some layer keeps, replacing the row with the same kind and item. steps: [{ n, action, target, item, count, place, fact, confidence }]: step n replaces the step with that n or is added; place is { map, x, y, f } (uiMapID, map percent, f `e` for the Classic frame). note: where each fact comes from (an in-game check, a recording, a player report with its issue number, the game's data). Check an edit with `forge data check-corrections`. See docs/forge/data.md, Changing the data. Hand-checked mechanics fixes, applied over every layer and always driving the route, live in forever-db/corrections/mechanics.json.

steps.fact: Sovik's window lists no quest: pick his chat option, the one that is not his goods, and Chief Engineer Scooty opens.

2842.note: Chief Engineer Scooty (2842) is offered from Sovik's (3413) chat option (gossip option 95758), never from his window's quest list. Source: players' in-game recordings to 2026-11-11: 11 people opened it, every one through that option, and no window of his in the recordings listed it; the player report #1762. The server data puts the same option in his menu, beside his goods, and asks for Rig Wars (2841) in the log: 10 of the 11 people had it, one did not.

steps.fact: Grimclaw, the white bear by the road, knows where Volcor is: target him and type /wave, and he shows you the way to Volcor's cave.

993.note: A Lost Master (993): the quest's text only says to find Volcor (3692) in Darkshore; Grimclaw (3695), his bear, answers a wave by pointing the way. Source: the server data (Grimclaw's reaction to the Wave emote); the leveling guide's hand-in sends players into Blackwood Den. A help, not a requirement. #4046's sweep of the quests done with an emote.

steps.fact: "Plucky" Johnson is the small grey chicken pecking around the foot of the race track's lookout tower. Target him and type /beckon: he turns human for a short while, and only then can you talk to him.

1950.note: Get the Scoop (1950): Plucky (6626), the NPC its talk objective names, is a chicken nobody can talk to until a /beckon turns him human. Source: the server data (his reaction to the Beckon emote is a cast of "Plucky" Resumes Human Form, and no other emote does it); the Mage wand class guide says the same; Soffish's report (#4046), whose Lookup pick-up list for the Scarlet Monastery sent them to talk to him without it.

steps.fact: Once both flares are fired, walk up to Taskmaster Fizzule, target him and type /salute. In any other order he attacks.

2458.note: Deep Cover (2458): Taskmaster Fizzule (7233) is contacted with two flares and then the salute. Source: the quest's own text ("Fire off TWO flares, then approach Taskmaster Fizzule and perform the Shattered /Salute"); the server data (his reaction to the Salute emote); the Rogue poisons guide's step. #4046's sweep of the quests done with an emote.

steps.fact: After you take the quest, Shenthul speaks three lines and salutes you. Then target him and type /salute.

2460.note: The Shattered Salute (2460): the objective is a salute to Shenthul (3401), which the game stores as a kill of him. Source: the quest's own text ("Perform the Shattered Salute on Shenthul"); the server data (a salute at him gives this quest's credit); the Rogue poisons guide's step. #4046's sweep of the quests done with an emote.

steps.fact: Target Doc Mixilpixil and type /lay beside him, then stay down while he examines you.

2608.note: The Touch of Zanzil (2608): the diagnosis starts when you lie down by Doc Mixilpixil (7207). Source: the quest's own text ("/Lay down to be examined by Doc Mixilpixil"); the server data (the Doc's reaction to that emote); the Duskwood leveling guide's step. #4046's sweep of the quests done with an emote.

steps.fact: With the Special Chicken Feed in your bags, target your chicken and type /cheer at it until it turns friendly (green), then give it the feed. Right-clicking it before that attacks it.

3861.note: CLUCK! (3861): the chicken takes the feed only once a cheer has made it friendly. Source: the quest's own text ("/cheer at it before trying to give it the Special Chicken Feed"); the Chicken Egg pet guide's step. #4046's sweep of the quests done with an emote.

steps.fact: With the Nutritious Slime Sludge in your bags, target an Excitable Slime in the canals and type /dance until it dances back, then give it the sludge. If it seems tired, dance with it again.

97583.note: WRIGGLE. (97583): the slime takes the sludge once a dance has caught its attention. Source: the quest's own text ("If it seems tired, try dancing with it again to catch its attention"). #4046's sweep of the quests done with an emote.

steps.fact: Rabine Saturna offers A Reliquary of Purity only after you have been inside Dire Maul once: go into Dire Maul, come back, ask her about Dire Maul, and the quest opens.

5527.note: A Reliquary of Purity (5527) is not offered by Rabine Saturna (11801) until the player has entered Dire Maul. Source: two player reports (#3104, #3270), one of them tried it: after zoning into Dire Maul East and asking Rabine about Dire Maul, the quest opened. Players' in-game recordings to 2026-11-20 agree: Rabine refused it to 6 people who could take it (level 56 and up) and offered it to 4; one person's windows at level 57 refused it six times before one offered it.

steps.fact: Goblin Lockpicks never goes into the quest log: Pick Pocket the Venture Co. Work Order first, then hand it to Veenix at one talk. He takes it only while The Horn of Xelthos is in your quest log: take that from C's Dead Drop by Pyrewood Village first.

78270.note: Goblin Lockpicks (78270) is handed in to Veenix (4086) at one talk, only while The Horn of Xelthos (78261) is in the quest log. Source: players' in-game recordings to 2026-11-20: 10 people handed it in to Veenix, none with an accept or the quest in the log first; ys's report (#3161) found the order wrong; every window of his that listed it came from a Rogue with 78261 in the log (9 people), and one was refused it in the window after 78261 had left the log; Traesheur's report (#3213), whose log had no 78261 when Veenix gave nothing.

steps.fact: Kill Tideress in Mystral Lake with Stonetalon Standstill (25) in your log or handed in: only then does she drop the Befouled Water Globe that starts the quest.

1918.note: The Befouled Element (1918) starts from the Befouled Water Globe (16408), which Tideress (12759) drops only for a player who has Stonetalon Standstill (25) in the log or handed in. Source: players' in-game recordings to 2026-11-08: the 7 people who took 1918 all had 25 (6 in the log, 1 handed in), 2 people without it killed Tideress and got no globe, and the player report #1346. The loot tables of the Classic servers have only a Horde condition on the globe.

steps.fact: Jailor Eston in Durnholde Keep carries the Dull Iron Key: it opens Drull's lock.
Jailor Marlgen in Durnholde Keep carries the Burnished Gold Key: it opens Tog'thar's lock.
Open Tog'thar's ball and chain with the Burnished Gold Key.
Open Drull's ball and chain with the Dull Iron Key.

498.note: The Rescue (498): each locked ball and chain opens only with its jailor's key. Source: players' in-game recordings to 2026-11-17: Jailor Eston's (2427) loot held the Dull Iron Key (3467) for 37 people and Jailor Marlgen's (2428) the Burnished Gold Key (3499) for 40; 58 people ticked each lock, Drull's (objective 1) at 75.3,41.6 and Tog'thar's (objective 2) at 79.8,39.6; and Acen's report (#2512), where the guide sent him to the locks without the keys.

steps.fact: Get four Shiny Red Apples: Homer Stonefield sells them, and Elwynn's kobolds and crates drop them too.

Click the Applejack Still north of the Westbrook Garrison with the four apples in your bags: it takes them and gives you a Thunder Applejack on the spot. The quest has no accept and never shows in your quest log.

91736.note: The Applejack Still (91736) is handed in at the still (object 562131) the moment it is clicked with four Shiny Red Apples (4536), and gives the Thunder Applejack (247824). Source: Players' in-game recordings since launch (4 hand-ins of 91736 at the still, no accept and no quest window; a player who drank the Thunder Applejack was shown only Sergeant De Vries's shop) and the player reports #820 and #823.

steps.fact: Sergeant De Vries has An Apple Treat only while you carry the Thunder Applejack from the Applejack Still. Without it he opens only his shop; with it, talking to him goes straight to the hand-in.

91738.note: An Apple Treat (91738) is offered by Sergeant De Vries (npc 955) only while the player carries the Thunder Applejack (247824) from The Applejack Still (91736); there is no accept window. Source: Players' in-game recordings since launch (4 hand-ins of 91736 at the still, no accept and no quest window; a player who drank the Thunder Applejack was shown only Sergeant De Vries's shop) and the player reports #820 and #823.

steps.fact: Dorius Stonetender at the Grimesilt Dig Site gives the quest, and the escort starts as soon as you take it.
Keep Dorius alive while he walks north-east to Dustfire Valley.
When it is over, read the Singed Letter he leaves on the road.

3367.note: Suntara Stones (3367) is an escort: Forever's quest data lists its one objective as the Dorius Escort event, ending at the Singed Letter (object 175704) in Dustfire Valley, and the server data marks it an escort. Taken and left behind, it fails, so the route takes it right before the walk.

95885.note: The Offering of Blood (95885): the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril hands over a Tortured Soul (210713) with the quest; used beside the stone it makes the offering and summons the elite Tortured Soul (212753), whose kill completes the quest. Source: players' in-game recordings to 2026-11-08, 12 people (4 established), the offering cast at the stone a few seconds after the accept with no item looted, then the kill ticking the quest's last line (#1317).

steps.fact: Use the Demon Pick on the red Hand of Iruxos Crystal in the middle of the largest building of Thunder Axe Fortress: a Demon Spirit comes out.
Kill the Demon Spirit (level 37) for the Demon Box.

5381.note: Hand of Iruxos: the game's data gives the quest the Demon Pick (14523) as its source item, the Hand of Iruxos Crystal (object 176581) at 54.95,26.66 and the Demon Spirit (11876) beside it, which drops the Demon Box (13542, 100%); EG Link's live quest record lists the pick with the box. The guide said to use the pick on the spirit.

steps.fact: Use the Gem of the Serpent on the Serpent Statue on Ranazjar Isle, off Desolace's northern tip: Lord Kragaru rises.
Kill Lord Kragaru (level 38) for the Book of the Ancients.

6027.note: Book of the Ancients: the game's data gives the quest the Gem of the Serpent (15766) as its source item and puts the Serpent Statue (object 177673) and Lord Kragaru (12369) at 28.24,6.67; EG Link's live quest record lists the gem with the book.

steps.fact: Open Giant Softshell Clams on the sea floor north of Shadowprey for Soft-shelled Clams; Enraged Reef Crawlers drop some too.
Open each Soft-shelled Clam in your bags for its meat.

6142.note: Clam Bait: the game's data has the meat (15924) inside the Soft-shelled Clam (15874), which comes from the Giant Softshell Clam objects (177784, 100%) and the Enraged Reef Crawlers (12347); 2 recorded players collected the meat on that coast.

steps.fact: Drink the Water Sapta (Islen Waterseer's reward for the previous part) by the standing stone south-west of the Sepulcher to see the Corrupt Minor Manifestation of Water.

63.note: Call of Water (63): Islen Waterseer gives the Water Sapta (6637) with Call of Water (220)'s hand-in (the game's quest reward data) and the quest requires it (requiredItems 6637); the elemental (5894) is at Silverpine 38.78,44.26 beside the Brazier of Everfount (113791).

steps.fact: Gather 8 Thundering Charms (4480), 8 Burning Charms (4479) and 8 Cresting Charms (4481) from the exiles of Arathi Highlands.

With Cyclonian (1712) in your log, click Bath'rah's Cauldron: its window asks for the 24 charms at once and hands you the Essence of the Exile (6851). There is nothing to accept, and the quest never shows in your quest log.

1714.note: Essence of the Exile (1714) is handed in at Bath'rah's Cauldron (object 89931) straight from the cauldron's window, which opens on the charms it wants ("The cauldron bubbles. Its vapors beckon...", then Continue): a player's in-game screenshot (#1699). The game's data marks 1714 as a quest handed in on the spot, repeatable, offered only while Cyclonian is in the log; players' recordings have never shown a quest of that kind accepted (66 such quests handed in, none taken).

steps.fact: Verog the Dervish does not wander the Stagnant Oasis on his own: he comes out when you kill the Kolkar centaurs there. Keep killing them until he appears.

851.note: Verog the Dervish (851): Verog (3395) appears at the Stagnant Oasis after Kolkar centaurs are killed there, not as a standing spawn. Source: players' in-game recordings to 2026-11-15: of 76 recorded Verog kills (61 people), 63 came within ten minutes of a Kolkar kill, a median of 25 seconds after the last one (Kolkar Marauders, Bloodchargers, Pack Runners); and Corey's report (#2479).

steps.fact: Negolash is not standing anywhere: hand in Enticing Negolash (619) at the Ruined Lifeboat on the shore south-east of Booty Bay, with 10 Barbecued Buzzard Wings and 5 Junglevine Wine, and he comes to the boat. Kill him there for Smotts' Cutlass.

8554.note: Facing Negolash (8554): Negolash (1494) is called up by Enticing Negolash (619), a quest started and ended at the Ruined Lifeboat (object 2289) that takes 10 Barbecued Buzzard Wings (4457) and 5 Junglevine Wine (4595). Source: the game's data (619's start and end at object 2289, its two item objectives; 8554's text asks for the food in the lifeboat); players' in-game recordings to 2026-11-17: 619 handed in by 1 person, Negolash seen by 5 people only at 30-32,72-82 and killed by 2 there; and Soggy's report (#2711).

steps.fact: Keep the Glowing Gem that Raene gives you in your bags. Shael'dryn needs it at the moonwell; if you banked it, collect it before going there.

1024.note: The server lists one Glowing Gem as both supplied and required. In #3043 the quest log showed no item counter at the moonwell.

steps.fact: In Dun Garok, use the Case of Fallrook Varietal by the fire on the lowest floor. Pick up the Sack of Homebrew Hops between the stairs and take it back to Brewmeister Bilger.

98071.note: The report in #3054 places the wine by the fire and the sack between the stairs. Two people recorded both counters, one in each order: the delivery is not a prerequisite for the hops.

steps.fact: Enter the Dor'Danil Barrow Den in southern Ashenvale and descend to the bottom for the Legacy of the Aspects.

1154.note: The quest describes the book at the bottom of the den. In #3069 the player was at its map point but had no directions underground.

steps.fact: Answer Braug Dimspirit's question with Neltharion. A wrong answer sends you away to Camp Taurajo, and you walk back to try again.

6627.note: Test of Lore (6627, Braug Dimspirit in Stonetalon, after The Legacy of the Aspects): the quest's only line is to answer his question correctly, and the guide never said the answer. A player's in-game report (#3028): a wrong answer teleports you to Camp Taurajo, and the right one is Neltharion.

steps.fact: Use the Crate of Radioactive Refuse five times in the Tanaris desert. Stay clear of Gadgetzan and move away from the last pile before using it again.

97536.note: The quest supplies the crate and describes where to empty it. Seven people's recordings show discard credit on cast 1303853; MIG reported the item use in #3159.

steps.fact: With the Mana Sieve in your bags, gather mana before you go to the pylons: the Sieve takes it from the Unstable Mana Rifts, the floating sparks along the road north. Each pylon needs its share of it.

At each pylon, use the Pile of Pylon Parts the quest hands over: its Repair and Recharge Pylon takes four Coalesced Mana Crystals. The Decrepit Pylon Protectors guard the pylons; most players pull one away first, but no kill is needed.

96018.note: Powering the Pylons (96018): the pylons are repaired with mana gathered with the Mana Sieve (255662) first; its objectives list only the Sieve and the two pylons. Source: the quest's own text ("use it to collect Ancient Mana Crystals. Once you have acquired enough mana, empower the pylons"); players' in-game recordings to 2026-11-17: the Unstable Mana Rifts (264149) seen by 54 people in Shen'dralas, and the pylons' lines ticking on a cast of spell 1289727 (30 people took the quest); Unholy's report (#2714), who counted four Coalesced Mana Crystals (255667) for each pylon. Spell 1289727 is the Pile of Pylon Parts' (271882, the quest's handed-over item; the client's item effect table), with four Coalesced Mana Crystals as its reagent (the client's spell reagent table); recordings to 2026-11-20: 79 of 79 pylon repairs ticked on it, 25 of them with no Decrepit Pylon Protector killed in the minute before (#4135).

steps.fact: Use the Makeshift Bandages Brother Lowley gives you on the Wounded Soldiers beside him; each one bandaged counts. Don't kill them.

96082.note: Doctor's Orderly (96082) is done by using the Makeshift Bandages (272126, given with the quest) on the Wounded Soldiers (263614) at Farholde Keep; the game stores the objective as a kill credit, so a step built from it said "Kill Wounded Soldier" (#2831). Source: players' in-game recordings to 2026-11-17: 31 people, every one of their 88 ticks right after a cast of Apply Bandage (spell 1290242) on a Wounded Soldier; the client's item tables give that spell as the bandages' use.

steps.fact: Twilight Champions in the cult's camps drop the Twilight Key: with one in your bags, free a captive Rog'mar Scout (the key unlocks his chains).

94748.note: Break Their Chains (94748): each scout is freed with a Twilight Key (265821), a quest item the Twilight Champions (256799) drop; the objective names only the scouts. Source: the game's item data (Twilight Key, a quest item; QuestieDB's Forever drop data puts it on the Twilight Champion); players' in-game recordings to 2026-11-20: 25 people, every tick of "Rog'mar Scout rescued" right after a cast of Unlocking (spell 1277271); Etienne's report (#3266).

steps.fact: The Vial of Earth Song Water is inside Maraudon, the five-player dungeon in Desolace: this quest needs a Maraudon run.

93404.note: Rot and Regret (93404): its vial (258296) comes only from an object (612179) that no outdoor spawn data places, and the quest's own text says "Venture to Maraudon and recover a Vial of Earth Song Water"; players' in-game recordings to 2026-11-20: 46 people looted it. Emil's report (#3243): the Razorfen Downs pick-up chain sent him through it with no word of the dungeon.

steps.fact: Franclorn Forgewright is a ghost only a dead character can see: die near his tomb in Blackrock Mountain and walk to him as a spirit to talk to him.

3801.note: Dark Iron Legacy (3801): its giver and ender, Franclorn Forgewright (8888), shows only to the dead. Source: Nostaroi's report (#3009: "you have to be dead to get this quest"); players' in-game recordings to 2026-11-20: 14 people met him at Forgewright's Tomb; the Thorium Brotherhood guide's step for the Shadowforge Key says the same.

steps.fact: Rotting Slimes in and around the Dor'danil Barrow Den leave a Rusty Chest when they die: open the chests until one holds the Iron Pommel.

1027.note: Raene's Cleansing (1027): the Iron Pommel (5519) comes only from Rusty Chests (19021), and the chests come from Rotting Slimes (3928). Source: Shuurajou's report (#3002: "they are inside and dropped by rotting slimes"); the chests' known points are spread over the barrow den's slopes, where the slimes roam, not set like a camp's; players' in-game recordings to 2026-11-20: pommel ticks right after a Rotting Slime was seen or killed.

steps.fact: Catch an Arbor Tarantula with the Bug Catching Net from Amaryllis Webb's Entomology Starter Kit: use the net on it, don't kill it.
Catch a Hay Weevil with the Bug Catching Net: use the net on it, don't kill it.
Catch a Flesh Picker with the Bug Catching Net: use the net on it, don't kill it.

93176.note: My Little Friends (93176): each specimen is caught by using the Bug Catching Net (213562, from the Entomology Starter Kit Amaryllis Webb gives with the quest) on an Arbor Tarantula (217588), a Hay Weevil (217589) or a Flesh Picker (217590). Our data listed the specimens as their drops, so the goal read "Kill Hay Weevil" (#3545). Source: players' in-game recordings to 2026-11-22: 22 people, every objective tick right after a cast of Collect Specimen (spell 434957); the client's item tables give that spell as the net's use.

steps.fact: At the gates of Stormwind, speak with Squire Rowe so he tells Reginald Windsor you are there; Windsor then comes to the gates, and you hand the quest in to him.

6402.note: Stormwind Rendezvous (6402, the Alliance's Onyxia chain): its turn-in, Reginald Windsor (12580), comes only after Squire Rowe (17804) is spoken to; the guide sent players to Windsor's spot without saying so. Source: the game's quest text ('venture to the city gates. Speak with Squire Rowe so that he may let Marshal Windsor know that you have arrived'); our NPC data has Squire Rowe and Windsor side by side at the gates.

steps.fact: An escort: follow Reginald Windsor from the gates through Stormwind to the keep and keep him alive. It ends in the throne room, where you speak to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon. Bring a group.

6403.note: The Great Masquerade (6403): an escort of Reginald Windsor (12580) whose one objective, Reginald's March, is met at Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep. Source: the game's quest text ('Follow Reginald Windsor through Stormwind. Protect him from harm!'); Forever's quest data places the objective by Bolvar (1453 79.7,38.8) and marks the quest for a group.

steps.fact: An escort inside Blackrock Depths: Marshal Windsor walks out of the prison, getting his gear back and freeing his friends on the way. Keep him alive, then report to Marshal Maxwell in the Burning Steppes.

4322.note: Jail Break! (4322, the Alliance's Onyxia chain): its one objective is an event with no place, so the guide said nothing about what to do. Source: the game's quest text ('Help Marshal Windsor get his gear back and free his friends. Return to Marshal Maxwell if you succeed'); the server data marks it an escort of Marshal Windsor (9023).

steps.fact: Speak to Thrall again after taking it and go through his whole story; it finishes the quest.

6566.note: What the Wind Carries (6566, the Horde's Onyxia chain): its one objective, Thrall's Tale, is met by listening to Thrall. Source: the game's quest text ('Listen to Thrall'); Forever's quest data places the objective at Thrall in Grommash Hold.

steps.fact: In Emberstrife's Den in the Wyrmbog, put on the Amulet of Draconic Subversion from Myranda the Hag and use it to take a black dragonkin's shape, then speak to Emberstrife.

6570.note: Emberstrife (6570, the Horde's Onyxia chain): Emberstrife (10321) talks only to a character wearing the Amulet of Draconic Subversion (16787, Oculus Illusions' reward). Source: the game's quest text ('wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife'); the server data has the quest use the amulet's Illusion: Black Dragonkin.

steps.fact: Fineous Darkvire carries Ironfel inside Blackrock Depths. Take it to the Shrine of Thaurissan and place it on Franclorn Forgewright's statue: that ends the quest and gives the Shadowforge Key.

3802.note: Dark Iron Legacy (3802): Ironfel (10999) drops from Fineous Darkvire (9056) and the quest ends at the Monument of Franclorn Forgewright (164689), both inside Blackrock Depths; it rewards the Shadowforge Key (11000). Source: the game's quest text ('Slay Fineous Darkvire and recover the great hammer, Ironfel. Take Ironfel to the Shrine of Thaurissan and place it on the statue of Franclorn Forgewright').

steps.fact: Bring the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater and use the mold by the lava lake: it forges the Unfinished Skeleton Key.

5801.note: Fire Plume Forged (5801, the Alliance's Scholomance key): the objective, the Unfinished Skeleton Key (14645), is made by using the Skeleton Key Mold (14644) at Fire Plume Ridge's lava lake, and the 2 Thorium Bars are in no objective. Source: the game's quest text ('Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake'); the server data has the mold's use at the lava lake (objects 4004, 177306).

steps.fact: Bring the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater and use the mold by the lava lake: it forges the Unfinished Skeleton Key.

5802.note: Fire Plume Forged (5802, the Horde's Scholomance key): as 5801. Source: the game's quest text ('Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake'); the server data has the mold's use at the lava lake (objects 4004, 177306).

steps.fact: Use the Beacon Torch standing in the doorway of each of Andorhal's four towers to mark it.

5097.note: All Along the Watchtowers (5097, the Alliance's Scholomance key): its four objectives are tower markers marked with the Beacon Torch (12815). Source: the game's quest text ('Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower'); the server data has the torch's use at the four towers.

steps.fact: Use the Beacon Torch standing in the doorway of each of Andorhal's four towers to mark it.

5098.note: All Along the Watchtowers (5098, the Horde's Scholomance key): as 5097. Source: the game's quest text ('Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower'); the server data has the torch's use at the four towers.

steps.fact: Marshal Windsor is held in the prison of Blackrock Depths; find his cell and speak to him.

4241.note: Marshal Windsor (4241, the Alliance's Onyxia chain): its turn-in, Marshal Windsor (9023), has no open-world spawn; the Codex places him in Blackrock Depths. Source: the game's quest text ('enter Blackrock Depths. Find out what became of Marshal Windsor. You recall Ragged John talking about Windsor being dragged off to a prison').

steps.fact: Kill Maddened Rotclaws (25-26) in the Green Belt and the hills north of it for the Malignant Rotclaw Flesh.
Use the Malignant Rotclaw Flesh at Carnage's lair on the hill north of the Dragonmaw Gates: Carnage comes out to it.
Kill Carnage (level 30, elite) for Carnage's Head.

98283.note: Carnage (98283): Carnage (271336) only comes out when the Malignant Rotclaw Flesh (280331), a Maddened Rotclaw's (271334) drop, is used at his lair; the guide listed his head first and the flesh only once the head was in the bags (#3804, holyjezus). Source: players' in-game recordings: the flesh's cast (spell 1308246) 13 times, every one at Wetlands 70,29, Carnage's spawn; of the 39 people whose recordings have both items, 33 had the flesh first.

steps.fact: Use the Soul Gem on Yenniku while he is alive: the gem fills (the Filled Soul Gem). Don't kill him.

592.note: Saving Yenniku (592): the Filled Soul Gem (3913) comes from using the Soul Gem (3912) on Yenniku (2530) while he is alive; our quest data lists it as his drop, so the step read "Kill Yenniku for Filled Soul Gem" before the gem's use (#3825, Meta). Source: an in-game check: the reporter used the gem on him alive and the quest completed (592 done in the report's quest log).

steps.fact: Kill the Cannibal Ghouls around Corin's Crossing: a Darrowshire Spirit rises where one dies.
Gibbering Ghouls around Corin's Crossing leave a Darrowshire Spirit too.
Diseased Flayers around Corin's Crossing leave a Darrowshire Spirit too.
Talk to each Darrowshire Spirit to free it (objective 1).

5211.note: Defenders of Darrowshire (5211): the Darrowshire Spirits (11064) it asks you to free are not in the world; each rises where one of the Scourge around Corin's Crossing dies (Cannibal Ghoul 8530, Gibbering Ghoul 8531, Diseased Flayer 8532). The guide's target button looked for the spirits alone. Source: Zack's report (#3309) and its confirmation; the quest's text.

steps.fact: Stand in the First Tide Pool, on Southridge Beach, and use Empty Vial Labeled #1 (from the Box of Empty Vials): the vial fills; the pool itself cannot be clicked.
Stand in the Second Tide Pool, north along the shore, and use Empty Vial Labeled #2 (from the Box of Empty Vials): the vial fills; the pool itself cannot be clicked.
Stand in the Third Tide Pool and use Empty Vial Labeled #3 (from the Box of Empty Vials): the vial fills; the pool itself cannot be clicked.
Stand in the Fourth Tide Pool, the northernmost, and use Empty Vial Labeled #4 (from the Box of Empty Vials): the vial fills; the pool itself cannot be clicked.

3568.note: Seeping Corruption (3568): the quest's source item is the Box of Empty Vials (10695, the game's quest data), which holds Empty Vial Labeled #1-#4 (10687-10690); the four tide pools (152598, 152604, 152605, 152606) are spell-focus objects (type 8 in forever-db's object.jsonl), so each vial fills when it is used at its own pool. Source: the in-game check on #3857 (a level 54 Horde hunter at the Second Tide Pool: clicking the pool does nothing); the places are the #3211 record's, south to north.

steps.fact: Use Smeed's Kodo Kombobulator on an Aged, Dying or Ancient Kodo in the Kodo Graveyard: it becomes a tamed kodo that follows you. Don't kill it.
Walk the tamed kodo back to Smeed's camp and talk to it there: that counts it. Five kodos, one at a time.

5561.note: Kodo Roundup (5561): the five kodos are tamed with the Kodo Kombobulator (13892, given with the quest) and each counts once talked to at Smeed Scrabblescrew's camp; the game stores the objective as a kill credit (Aged, Dying or Ancient Kodo), so Lookup's quest guide said "Kill Aged Kodo" (#4188). Source: players' in-game recordings to 2026-11-10: 8 people ran it and the line ticked as they talked to a tamed Aged (13 times), Dying (19) or Ancient Kodo (9), never on a kill (correction 5561, #1614).
